info.title: bunvex Deployment API
info.description: The admin API of a bunvex deployment: environment variables, the audit log, usage limits, canonical URLs, log streams, pausing and data sync.

post.description: Set or delete environment variables, all in one change. Every subscription is invalidated, since functions read them.

get.description: Every environment variable of the deployment, with its value.
The deployment's audit log from a time on, the oldest event first, a page at a time: pass `pagination.nextCursor` back as `cursor`, with the same `from`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first time to include, in milliseconds since the epoch; the same on every page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many events a page has at most: 15 by default, 100 at most.

get.description: Each usage limit metric's usage in the current UTC day and month. Only a `complete` `seedStatus` means the windows include what came before the server started.
Every usage limit set on the deployment.

post.description: Add a usage limit. A metric has at most one limit per window and limit type.
Set the public URL of the deployment's API or of its HTTP actions, which functions read as `BUNVEX_CLOUD_URL` and `BUNVEX_SITE_URL`; without `url`, go back to the server's own.

get.description: The public URLs of the deployment's API and HTTP actions.
Every log stream of the deployment, with its configuration and status.

post.description: Add a log stream. A deployment has at most one of each type.
Change a log stream: a field left out keeps its value, and `null` clears it.
Give a webhook log stream a new signing secret.
Stop the deployment, keeping its data: function calls fail, scheduled functions wait, and cron jobs are skipped until it is unpaused.
Start a paused deployment again; the scheduled functions that waited run.

Export the deployment's data, or part of it, a page at a time, then its changes. Pass each page's `pagination.nextCursor` back as `cursor`; the first call has none. A one-time export stops at the first `upToDate` page; a continuous one keeps asking, best with a pause after an `upToDate` page. Needs the ViewData operation.

get.description: The data syncs that fetched a page in the last 3 days, with their progress.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many syncs a page has at most: 50 by default, 100 at most.

get.description: One data sync's progress, by the `syncId` its pages carry; 404 once it has not fetched a page for 3 days. Needs the ViewData operation.

ActiveDataSync.description: Where an active data sync stands, as of the last page it fetched.

lastUpdated.description: When the sync last fetched a page, in milliseconds since the epoch.

AuditLogActor.description: Who made a change: the deployment itself, or the member an admin key belongs to.

hmacSecret.description: The secret each request's signature is computed with.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page; none for the first page.

selection.description: The components, tables and columns to sync; everything when absent.

DataSyncResponse.description: One page of a data sync.

truncates.description: Tables to empty before applying `values`: they are synced again from the start.

values.description: The documents written or deleted, in the order to apply them.

pagination.description: The sync never ends: `hasMore` is always true and `nextCursor` always set.

value.description: The document's fields, or only its `_id` when it was deleted.

createTime.description: When it happened, in milliseconds since the epoch.

clientIp.description: The address the request came from, when known.

clientUserAgent.description: The request's user agent, when known.

metrics.description: Each usage limit metric's usage, by its name.

seedStatus.description: Whether the windows' usage includes what came before the server started.

syncs.description: The syncs that fetched a page in the last 3 days, the latest first.

items.description: The page's events, the oldest first.

environmentVariables.description: Each variable's value, by its name.

LogTopic.description: A kind of event a log stream can receive.

Selection.description: What to sync: components by path (the root component is `""`), and what `_other` ones get.

url.description: The URL; none to go back to the server's own.

value.description: The new value; none to delete the variable.

limit.description: The limit, in the metric's unit.

WindowUsageResponse.description: Usage in the current UTC day and month, in the metric's unit.

Admin Key.name: Authorization
Admin Key.description: The deployment's admin key, after the `Bunvex ` prefix: `Authorization: Bunvex <admin_key>`. `bunvex admin-key` prints one. A user's `Bearer` token is not accepted here.
